text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Acme Corp wants an on‑prem air‑gapped POC next week. Main asks: how we deliver installer (USB vs. side-loaded tar), delta/patch cadence, and signing model. @ankur-se can you confirm what we can commit to for a demo?

ankur-se: We can produce immutable installer bundles + signed delta patches. For air‑gapped flows we build an OCI tarball + metadata bundle. Constraints: 1) bundle size (we aim <10GB for USB), 2) customer must allow offline image import (registry pull blocked), 3) GPU runtime images may be large (~20GB) unless we supply quantized variant. If USB not allowed we can stage via secure rsync over a jumpbox.

jess-ps: Security checklist: we provide SBOM (CycloneDX/JSON), sha256 sums, and a signing cert (PEM) for each release. We also attach SCA scan artifacts. Legal will want the completed security questionnaire.

legal-qa: Please get their SecQ now — send to legal-qa@redwood.example. For licensing: offline POCs have a one‑time packaging fee plus hourly on‑site/remote support if we provide hands‑on install.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Created ticket DEPLOY-987 for "Acme airgapped bundle build + validation" — assignee: @ankur-se.

maria-sales: Demo target: Wed 10am PT. We need a validated bundle by Mon EOD to do dry‑run. Also customer asked pricing: is packaging included in enterprise POC or billed separately?

ankur-se: Packaging is an add‑on by default: $4k flat for a signed offline bundle + delta pipeline setup, plus $200/hr for support. We can discount for POC — propose $1k and 8 support hours included. Note on upgrade cadence: our default cadence is quarterly signed deltas; critical hotfixes can be delivered out‑of‑band if agreed.

jess-ps: Additional technical notes for customer ops team: TLS cert rotation in air‑gapped mode is manual — we provide step docs and a small script for cert import. HSM/KMS: for fully offline key management we support customer‑supplied HSM with manual key injection.

ankur-se: Another installer detail — if they require signed container images we can provide Notary/COSE signatures and include a verification step:

```
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature bundle.sig
```

jess-ps: Also flag: endpoint telemetry is disabled by default for air‑gapped installs; if they want opt‑in telemetry we provide outbound IP list and signed policy.

maria-sales: Blockers to surface to the account team: AV/EDR may quarantine binaries (customer asked). Also need confirmation on USB vs. jumpbox delivery, and sign-off on cost. I'm going to ask Acme to send the SecQ and confirm delivery method.

ankur-se: If they run strict EDR we can provide benign packaging and vendor whitelist guidance. For very locked environments we can split the bundle (mini bootstrap + large model chunk) to reduce AV false positives.

maria-sales: Great — I'll follow up with Acme and ping legal-qa when SecQ arrives. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

legal-qa: :eyes: please attach their SOC2 report or equivalent if available, speeds review.
